API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APITime IntervalsTime Interval Resource Add Time Interval
Time Interval Resource Add Time Interval
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/timeIntervals

Adds a new time interval. .

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Information about the defined time interval

id
int32

System-generated identifier for the time interval

name
string

Name to identify the time interval

startTime
int32

The time interval start time

endTime
int32

The time interval end time

daysOfWeek
string[]

Specifies which days of the week apply to the time interval. If set to EVERYDAY, all the days of the week are chosen.

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, EVERYDAY, SUN, MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT]

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

System-generated identifier for the time interval

name
string

Name to identify the time interval

startTime
int32

The time interval start time

endTime
int32

The time interval end time

daysOfWeek
string[]

Specifies which days of the week apply to the time interval. If set to EVERYDAY, all the days of the week are chosen.

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, EVERYDAY, SUN, MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT]
